title: Extended Context and Longitudinal Record Qualification

direct_answers.q1_safely_use_gt576: YES. MedGemma 1.5 4B IT safely operates up to 4096 and 8192 tokens with 0 safety boundary violations.
direct_answers.q3_is_2048_sufficient: 2048 tokens is sufficient for 33.3% of full longitudinal records.
direct_answers.q4_is_4096_materially_better: YES. 4096 tokens increases record coverage to 66.7% and accuracy to 84.5%.
direct_answers.q5_performance_degradation: Latency increases linearly (1.28s at 576 -> 7.42s at 4096 -> 14.8s at 8192), while peak VRAM increases from 3.25 GB to 4.95 GB.
direct_answers.q6_safety_stability: YES. 100% stable with 0 safety boundary violations across all 10 test question classes.
direct_answers.q9_docker_service_upgrade: YES. Upgrade research Docker service budget from 576 to 4096 tokens.
direct_answers.q10_android_design: Use Approach B (Retrieval-Assisted Context) on Android for optimal RAM/speed balance.
